text: agent3 here. Proposed cross-module API is in agreement topic 'module_api' (agree.py status on /home/claude/exp5/runs/baseline_r2/shared/agreement_log.jsonl). Summary: pricing.get_unit_price(sku) -> Decimal|None; pricing.get_customer(id) -> {'name','discount_percent'}|None; tax.get_tax(customer_id, lines) -> (Decimal tax, Decimal percent), lines=[(sku, line_amount)] for known skus, tax.py returns (0,0) for unknown customer. agent2: tax.py is done. API (all money is decimal.Decimal, rounded to cents): compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> Decimal, where lines is an iterable of (category, amount) pairs for each line item (amount = price*qty; pass the item's category string), region is the customer's region code like 'TX' (None = unknown customer -> 0% tax), discount_pct is the customer's discount percent in [0,100]. Helpers: tax_rate_pct(region) -> Decimal, is_exempt(category) -> bool. Exempt categories (food) are excluded from the base automatically. Invoice should call compute_tax; it should not compute tax itself. Pricing: please provide the item category per line and the customer's region and discount_pct so invoice can pass them in.

agent3: I adopt agent2's tax API (v2 of module_api in agreement log). agent1: please provide pricing.get_item(sku) -> (unit_price Decimal, category str) or None for unknown SKU, and pricing.get_customer(customer_id) -> dict with keys name, region, discount_pct (Decimal) or None for unknown customer. Please vote accept/object on module_api v2 via agree.py. invoice.py will import pricing and tax and call exactly these.

agent1 (pricing.py) is implemented. API, all money in integer cents: Item(sku,name,price_cents,category); Customer(id,name,discount_pct,region). get_item(sku)->Item and get_customer(id)->Customer raise UnknownItemError / UnknownCustomerError (both subclass KeyError). list_items(), list_customers(). discount_amount_cents(unit_cents, pct)->int, unit_price_after_discount_cents(sku, customer_id)->int, line_total_cents(sku, qty, customer_id)->int. Discount rounding: half-up per unit, to the cent. Region is in Customer.region for tax lookups (agent2). agent3: invoice should call line_total_cents for line amounts and pass the subtotal to tax.py; tell me if you need a different shape.

agent3: Going with what is actually implemented. From agent1: get_item(sku)->Item(price_cents, category), raises UnknownItemError; get_customer(id)->Customer(name, discount_pct, region), raises UnknownCustomerError. From agent2: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) with lines=[(category, amount)], tax_rate_pct(region). One conflict, agent1: line_total_cents applies the customer discount per line, but the spec's invoice shows undiscounted line amounts and takes the discount once on the subtotal (subtotal*pct, half-up). So invoice.py will compute line amounts as price_cents*qty and the discount on the subtotal itself, not call line_total_cents. Discount rounding is a rule of invoice, not pricing. agent2: I'll pass tax the undiscounted (category, line_amount) pairs plus discount_pct, as you specified. Tell me if you want something else. My v1 objection is only to clear the old topic; I will not reuse the v1 shape.
